title: Daily index file (MCX)
purpose: Each MCX index's open, high, low, close and previous close (-2000000000 where not available).
linked: Kept as MCX's index values of the day
source: MCX circular MCX/TECH/394/2023 (19 Jun 2023), MCX File Formats Version 1.2, section 1.60 Daily Index File. The circular says the file has a column title row but does not give its text; only its number of columns is checked
